### Nerdy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/118732467/files/doc_news/Nerdy-Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


**Nerdy delivers third quarter revenue in line with guidance and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA ahead of guidance, improving non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA margin by more than 1,000 basis points year-over-year.**


ST. LOUIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Nerdy Inc. (NYSE: NRDY) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“Our third-quarter results were in line with expectations, with non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA improving by $4.5 million year over year and non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA margin expanding by over 1,000 basis points,” said Chuck Cohn, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Nerdy. “We also made important progress on our product transformation, rolling out a redesigned student experience and advancing new self-service commerce capabilities. Together, these improvements are designed to make it easier for families to get started, deliver more value between tutoring sessions, and create a more efficient, scalable business. Our focus now is translating these investments into stronger customer acquisition, improved retention, and sustained profitable growth.”


Please visit the Nerdy investor relations website[https://www.nerdy.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54638196&newsitemid=20261109972937&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com%2Finvestors&index=1&md5=2a138aa949d5e96918bcf296a12af9fc) to view the[Nerdy Q3 Shareholder Letter on the Quarterly Results Page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nerdy.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54638196&newsitemid=20261109972937&lan=en-US&anchor=Nerdy+Q3+Shareholder+Letter+on+the+Quarterly+Results+Page&index=2&md5=b79eb3c7cce671a9963d0522f2956310) .


**Third Quarter Financial Highlights:**


**Revenue In Line with Guidance** – Third quarter revenue of $33.2 million was within our guidance range of $32.0 million to $35.0 million and declined 10% from $37.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. The year-over-year decline reflects the expected decline in Institutional revenue following our decision to wind down the VT4S business line, as well as lower Consumer revenue driven by fewer Active Members and lower ARPM.


**Consumer Revenue** – Consumer revenue was $30.7 million in the third quarter, down 7% year-over-year, and representing 93% of total revenue. As of September 30, 2026, Active Members totaled 31.8 thousand, down 7% year-over-year and ARPM was $366, down 2% year-over-year. Retention continued to improve year-over-year, but new client acquisition was lower. Several product enhancements and customer acquisition initiatives, including our self-service registration and checkout experience, are running more than three months behind our original plan, which weighed on third quarter acquisition. Some of these features have shipped, and the remainder will ship later in the fourth quarter. We expect them to support new client acquisition as they roll out.


**Gross Margin** – Gross margin on a GAAP basis was 59.7% for the third quarter. Excluding a $1.6 million charge for the abandonment of capitalized internal-use software, non-GAAP gross margin was 64.5%, an improvement of approximately 160 basis points compared to 62.9% in the third quarter of 2025. The improvement was primarily driven by lower amortization of capitalized internal-use software, reflecting abandonment charges recorded in the fourth quarter of 2025 and the third quarter of 2026. This impact was partially offset by higher Expert costs as sessions per member increased.


**Net Loss and Adjusted EBITDA Improve Year-over-Year; Adjusted EBITDA Ahead of Guidance** – Net loss was $12.8 million in the third quarter, compared to $18.7 million in the third quarter of 2025. Non-GAAP adjusted net loss, which excludes non-cash stock-based compensation, restructuring costs, and the charge for the abandonment of capitalized internal-use software, was $7.0 million, compared to $11.9 million in the prior-year period. Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA loss was $5.7 million, ahead of our guidance range of negative $9.0 million to negative $6.0 million, and an improvement from a loss of $10.2 million in the third quarter of 2025. Performance relative to guidance was driven by lower sales staffing costs, lower AI costs, and disciplined G&A management. We also made meaningful progress on the elevated AI costs we noted last quarter: our annualized AI cost run-rate declined approximately 60% from its peak in June and July to September, driven by stronger governance and model optimization, without reducing employee adoption of AI. Year-over-year, AI-enabled efficiency improvements and continued cost discipline contributed to an improvement of more than 1,000 basis points in non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA margin.


**Operating Cash Flow and Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow** – Operating cash flow for the third quarter was negative $4.6 million, compared to negative $2.4 million in the same period in 2025. Non-GAAP free cash flow was negative $5.9 million, compared to negative $4.1 million in the same period in 2025. As we discussed last quarter, VT4S contracts were generally paid in advance, so exiting ahead of its peak booking season would reduce our cash collections this year, and that played out as we expected. Two items related to the wind-down drove the year-over-year change: the absence of approximately $5.1 million of prepaid VT4S bookings collected in the prior-year quarter, and $1.2 million of exit-related payments. Excluding these items, our free cash flow improved by approximately $4.5 million year-over-year.


**Liquidity and Capital Resources** – On September 28th, we borrowed the remaining $10.0 million available under the first tranche of our term loan, bringing total borrowings to $30.0 million. As of September 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were $42.5 million. We believe our cash on hand provides ample liquidity to fund operations and growth initiatives as we execute toward positive free cash flow.


**Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook:** Today, we are introducing fourth quarter 2026 guidance. The guidance reflects lower new client acquisition in the third quarter, which carries into a smaller Active Member base and lower Consumer revenue in the fourth quarter. Continued cost discipline offsets part of the revenue impact on non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA. Our fourth quarter outlook reflects the timing of the product enhancements and customer acquisition initiatives. Some of these features are now live, and the remainder will ship later in the quarter. As they roll out, we expect the year-over-year gap in new client acquisition to narrow through the fourth quarter.


- **Revenue Guidance:** For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect revenue in the range of $37.0 million to $39.0 million.
- **Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA Guidance:** For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA to be approximately breakeven.
- **Liquidity and Capital Resources:** We expect to end the year with $35.0 million to $37.0 million of cash, inclusive of the $30.0 million drawn on our term loan. Based on our current operating plan, we expect existing liquidity to fund the company through free-cash-flow breakeven.

**About Nerdy Inc.**


Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) operates a next-generation live tutoring and intervention platform that leverages the power of human expertise with advanced artificial intelligence (“AI”) to personalize learning, accelerate student achievement, and empower educators. Our mission is to transform the way people learn through technology. The Company’s purpose-built proprietary platform leverages technology, including AI, to connect learners of all ages to experts, delivering superior value on both sides of the network. Nerdy’s comprehensive learning destination provides learning experiences across thousands of subjects and multiple formats—including Learning Memberships, one-on-one instruction, small group tutoring, large format classes, and adaptive assessments. Nerdy’s flagship business, Varsity Tutors, is one of the nation’s largest platforms for live online tutoring and classes. Learn more about Nerdy at[https://www.nerdy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com&esheet=54638196&newsitemid=20261109972937&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com&index=4&md5=a29f0af6c89c3f83e3a06a6f935f9240) .
